get.summary: Report that the API is serving
How the web screen signs people in

put.description: Creates the workspace with its language, models, run limits and execution mode. Only Anthropic and OpenAI models are routed by the hosted service. An existing workspace is never overwritten: creating it again answers 409.

get.summary: Read a workspace's configuration

put.summary: Select the knowledge bases a workspace's runs use
put.description: Replaces the selection; it applies from the next run. Each knowledge base must be ready: active, with every source's file held.

combinationApproved.description: Required to combine several knowledge bases in one workspace's runs.

put.description: Saves the text as a new version and makes it the policy the workspace's next runs follow. Setting the same text again keeps its version.

content.description: The policy as Markdown; at most 64 KiB once encoded as UTF-8.

get.summary: Read a workspace's active writing policy
List a workspace's writing policy versions, without their text

post.summary: Create a job brief from pasted sources

get.summary: Read a job brief, latest or at one version

patch.summary: Edit a job brief, saving a new draft version
patch.description: Replaces the patch's fields on the latest version and saves the result as a new draft. A stale expectedVersion answers 409, so an edit never overwrites one the client has not seen.

get.summary: List a job brief's versions, oldest first

post.summary: Mark a job brief version as reviewed

get.summary: List a workspace's job applications, the default one first
Read one job application

post.summary: Begin a run; a worker executes it
post.description: Persists the run and its context without calling a provider, then queues it for a worker. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same run and queues it again if it is not already waiting.

modelProfiles.description: Exact author and critic profile versions bound to this run, such as a preset's pair; their models replace the workspace's for this run. Without them the run uses provider-default runtime controls and unknown context windows.

get.summary: Read a run's state
Read a run's review: the draft, its findings and its readiness

put.summary: Decide a finding of the run's current draft
put.description: Records the owner's decision on one finding, by the id the review gives it. Only a run awaiting approval takes decisions (409 review_closed otherwise); the latest decision for a finding wins.

put.summary: Edit a block of the run's current draft
put.description: Records the owner's replacement text for one block. The review shows the latest edit in place of the draft's text. Only a run awaiting approval takes edits (409 review_closed otherwise).

post.description: Approves a run awaiting approval after its independent critic review. When the final CV checks fail, it answers 409 readiness_blocked and the review's approvalCheck lists the blockers; approving past them needs readinessOverrideRationale.

readinessOverrideRationale.description: Required only when the final CV checks fail; recorded with the approval.

post.description: Stops a run that is not finished; a stopped run is never resumed. Stopping it again answers the stopped run.

post.summary: Ask for another round; a worker drafts it
post.description: Moves a run awaiting approval to revising, with the owner's optional direction for the author, then queues it. The API runs no model call. The round and budget limits apply (409 run_state_conflict). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key answers the same run and queues it again if needed.

candidateDirection.description: The owner's short direction for the next round's author, never career evidence.

post.description: Pauses a run that is drafting, reviewing or revising. A step already running finishes, and the worker leaves the run until the owner resumes it.

post.summary: Resume a paused run; a worker continues it
post.description: Lifts the owner's pause without running a step, then queues the run so a worker continues from its current step. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key answers the same run and queues it again if needed.

post.summary: Export the approved draft as Markdown, DOCX or PDF
post.description: Renders the approved draft, checks it, and stores the document with its checksum; the run becomes exported. A run not yet approved answers 409. PDFs come from the built-in writer. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key answers the same export.

templateId.description: A built-in rendering template, such as classic, modern or compact.

get.summary: List a run's exports, newest first
Download an exported document
get.description: Answers the document's bytes with its media type, as an attachment, and its SHA-256 in X-Content-SHA256. The bytes are checked against the export's recorded checksum first: a document that no longer matches answers 409 export_integrity and is never sent.

200.description: The document's bytes, in its media type.

schema.description: The document's bytes, in its media type.

get.summary: Read what a run used and cost, by company, model and route
Read the tenant's usage and estimated cost for a month

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The UTC month, as YYYY-MM; calls count in the month they completed in.

post.summary: Create a knowledge base for candidate sources

get.summary: List the tenant's knowledge bases
List a knowledge base's sources with their latest file's metadata

post.description: Send the file itself as the request body, with its media type as the Content-Type: application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, text/markdown, text/plain. The type is checked against the file's signature; the file is stored, never parsed here. The same bytes in the same knowledge base answer 200 with the existing source, so a retry is safe.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name, shown in source lists and evidence references.

get.summary: List a knowledge base's sensitivity rules

post.summary: Add a sensitivity rule to a knowledge base
post.description: Saves a new version of the rule list; it applies from the next run. A rule with the same id, or the same tier and match, is refused with 422.

tier.description: never-share sections never reach a provider; sensitive ones need the workspace's consent.

id.description: The rule's id; generated when absent.

delete.summary: Remove a sensitivity rule from a knowledge base
delete.description: Saves a new version of the rule list without the rule.

get.summary: Read who the caller is: the owner token or an organisation's member
List the members of the caller's organisation

post.summary: Invite a person to the caller's organisation by email
post.description: They become active on their first sign-in with that verified email.

patch.description: The organisation's last owner keeps the owner role.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the caller's organisation
delete.description: The organisation's last owner cannot be removed.

post.summary: Create an organisation and invite its first owner
post.description: Operator only: takes the deployment's owner token in both authentication modes, never a member's sign-in.

organisationId.description: Also the tenant id; it cannot change later.
